Nina: Onboarding sample app (JS) hitting a weird case — after a client timeout + reconnect we sometimes see chunks arrive out of order / final token duplicated. Repro on my laptop, attaching steps below.
Ben: which SDK and sampleapp version? quick repro would help.
Nina: js-sdk v0.8.1, sampleapp from /examples/streaming, repro: open, wait for 12s idle, abort, reconnect. JS client concatenates fragments, Go sample drops the final fragment — so parity mismatch. gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/repro (short log).
Jessica: hmm OK. Does the sample app set an idle timer that calls `controller.abort()`?
Nina: yes sampleapp has a 15s idle abort in the onboarding walkthrough to surface hung streams. But the runtime still emits the final completion chunk after the abort race.
Tariq: sounds like two things: 1) client abort triggers reconnect but we don't propagate Last-Event-Id so server may re-send a fragment; 2) JS SDK and Go SDK handle partial chunks differently on reconnect.
Ben: can you paste the chunk sequence you saw? even a minimal ascii trace helps.
Nina: sure — simplified stream log:
```
-> chunk A (partial JSON)
-> chunk B (partial JSON)
-- client abort triggers reconnect --
-> chunk B (resend final bytes)
-> chunk C (final token)
```
Result: JS merges B+B and yields valid final; Go treats the second B as a fresh fragment and drops overlap, losing one token.
Jessica: ugh. That'll bite onboarding users. Quick fix: sampleapp should forward `Last-Event-Id` or `x-last-event-id` on reconnect and the SDKs should be explicit about fragment stitch rules.
Samir: I'll open a PR to the sampleapp to remove the aggressive idle abort and add a note about how reconnects interact with fragment semantics. Also will add an e2e that simulates client abort+reconnect.
Tariq: SDK-side, we should add a compatibility test: JS, Go, Python clients must behave same when a reconnect yields overlapping fragment tails. Decide whether SDKs should coalesce overlapping bytes or prefer dedupe by last-event-id.
Ben: agree. Short term: change onboarding doc + sampleapp to not abort so easily, long term: add test harness and spec for 'fragment reassembly on reconnect'.
Jessica: I'll update the onboarding doc (section "streaming gotchas") and include the tiny code snippet we recommended:
```js
// recommended reconnect header handling
const lastId = localState.lastEventId;
fetch(url, {headers: {Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`, 'Last-Event-Id': lastId}})
```
Nina: thanks — that should unblock a lot of confused signups. Would be great to include a short note in the SDK changelog about the parity fix.
ci-bot: sampleapp PR #142 build passed :white_check_mark:
Samir: PR up: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/142 — changed idle timer, added docs, and e2e harness. Please review.
Ben: lovely. Follow-up: add a tiny integration test that injects a 50ms chunk reorder to catch regressions.
Nina: filed ticket INF-987 for tracking SDK parity work and onboarding updates. I'll attach repro steps and logs. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
